notes: Existing assets are scene-level; all shot directions currently crop the same image. Line indexes and chapter numbers are 1-based; id is the zero-based game chapter ID.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Welcome to SORA Garage. We can fix any car. The leaking roof is still waiting its turn.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: An opening present. Side A is for the mountain road. Side B is blank. We’ll record a good night on it.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: That is a very sweet excuse for not finishing your playlist.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: This is less sweet. They have called in the loan. Repay in three weeks, or surrender the workshop.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: Two years since your father died. You only just put your own sign up.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: I photographed that crown at the harbor. CROWN. I thought it was a sign for a new warehouse.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Show me later. Right now I need a way to keep this shutter open.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Repairs are booked through next month. Fix the lift and we could stop turning people away.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: That crown reached our depot too. Free tomorrow? There is a car I want you to see.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Hakone first. Tonight’s club meet gives all three podium drivers some time on air.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: If this is a broadcast asking people to pity me, I am not doing it.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I’m introducing a great mechanic. Terrible manners. Even her voice has engine oil on it.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: If I make the podium, read out our booking number. That is all I need.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: Take the ten-millimeter socket. Bravado will not turn a nut.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Dad kept this place going on his own. I can too.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Then give me my tools back. After you get home will do. I’ll see you at Hakone.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: You did not smile on the podium. You smiled listening to the car afterward. That is the photo I took.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Third gear stopped catching. Please photograph the cleaner hand.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Tonight’s messages for SORA Radio: three delivery-van inspections. We’re running out of paper by the phone.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: One is mine. I’ll bring the car my brother and I were restoring. He has stopped coming to the garage.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Are you missing parts?

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: What we’re missing is somewhere we can stay next month. I’ll explain at the harbor.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: I’ll leave the enlargement here. The garage and the harbor. The same crown on two doors.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I’ll come and look tomorrow. Just once. I cannot stop work here.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Take the cassette home. Don’t fill side B without me. Let me choose one song.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: If it is a terrible song, I’m recording over it. Goodnight, Ren.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: Taillights at night, milk crates in the morning. This is where the city starts moving.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I’ll look at the car, then go. I have customers waiting too.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: I know. The blue one. My brother painted the fender. The color still doesn’t match.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: In that redevelopment picture, the car and depot are gone. All the people, neatly erased too.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: If this closes, his apprenticeship ends too. The car was meant to celebrate his first job.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Daichi. Keeping my own workshop is already more than I can manage. I cannot carry the harbor too.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: I’m not asking you to carry it. I wanted you to see what he is waiting for.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: He sent a postcard to my midnight show. “Play something that helps my brother sleep.”

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: When Dad died, I thought everything would disappear if I slept. Sometimes I still do.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: That doesn’t mean you should break down with your eyes open. You would have let the car rest by now.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: If that car runs, I can take more night deliveries. Put something toward the renewal fee.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: With these brakes? No. Before you add another car to tonight’s work, we fix this one.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Can we invite the shopkeepers to tonight’s meet? I want to ask what they want in the photographs.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: A harbor podium gets every courier listening. Whether they stay for my jokes is another matter.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: We fix the car, then race. After that, I’ll listen. That is all I am promising.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: That is enough. Thank you for coming.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: Canned coffee for everyone. Still warm. Collect this before your podium congratulations.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Bring your brother’s car to the workshop tomorrow. Let him drive it before you put it on night deliveries.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: I will. Somehow I ended up holding the keys that were supposed to be his.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: The owner asked to be photographed outside her shop. Her face was better than any redevelopment illustration.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Fishmonger, printer, depot. The calls about that crown have not stopped since the broadcast.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I cannot ask all these people to save only my workshop. But where do we begin?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: Rei Sorashiro. My signature is on the assessment behind that crown.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: What do you want from us? Forgiveness?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: First, there is something I need you to see. What I put my name to.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: After closing tomorrow. I’ll hear you out. I am not promising forgiveness.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: The document I promised. CROWN’s initial assessment. I have not removed my signature.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Someone who helped set my workshop’s deadline is sitting in front of me. I will still hear you out.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: I believed it would create jobs. To get it approved, I made the objections look smaller.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Leave that page there. I’m photographing what you did as well as the plan.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: The money comes through the Meridian Council, an international financial syndicate. Japanese developers are partners too.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: First they expand property lending. Once prices are high enough, they withdraw together.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: So they can buy the workshops that cannot repay, cheaply?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: Then control of payments. A city where you cannot send wages unless a crown terminal allows it.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: They are taking more than the keys. Even the road home would belong to them.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Then we build another connection. This is my prototype. SORA X.O.R.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Three terminals check the same exchange record. I want shops to use the tokens with each other. No crown’s permission.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: More terminals need people willing to host them. I am not very good at asking.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: Your father did not buy this vise. He borrowed it from the body shop next door. It never went back.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I have used it every day for two years. I never even asked.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: If you’re going to be like your father, learn how he asked for help too.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Let’s find people at Hakone. This time, not just repair customers. I want us to build what comes next for the city.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: After the podium, I repaired an amplifier until dawn. So this is what finding allies looks like.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Five shops want a terminal. It is still a prototype, but the dream has left my desk.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: One shop at a time. I’ll keep the recovery key. Somebody has to be responsible.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Show me any design changes. I don’t want circuits out there that I cannot repair.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: I checked with the harbor shopkeepers. The photographs, notices and Rei’s account fit. I’ll put my name on the article.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: Keep my name in it too. Coming back from a race does not erase what I signed.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Another invitation. Toru Amamiya wants to show us a new workshop. SORA’s name is travelling fast.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I’ll go. I want to see the future he has drawn for us.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Then I’ll find a tie. Waiting for your answer already gets my throat tight enough.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Check your untied shoelace before your neck. Keep up, DJ.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: Did you see the black car downstairs? I’m taking it to Nikko tonight. I prefer that work to negotiations.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: Aki, this could be your workshop. Six lifts. A warehouse that keeps parts ready. Your SORA sign.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: No leaking roof. No second job through the night. Honestly, I want it.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Is the body shop next door in that drawing? The harbor depot?

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Celeste Vale. Meridian wants exclusive rights to SORA X.O.R. The workshop is what we offer in return.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: This red mark. You want the recovery key and the power to stop the network?

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Without someone who can stop it, order cannot be guaranteed. A city needs someone in charge.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: What happens to a shop that defies that person? Do you call it order when its terminal goes dark?

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: My father’s factory closed because funding failed for one week. Nobody could save it.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: I decided to become someone who could. I want to give you that power.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I want it. I have drawn a workshop like this so many times. If it would mean never being scared again, yes.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Aki. Don’t let this become another picture with our faces erased.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: But I don’t want a new lock on the shutter. I want us to decide who we open it for.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: I did not build SORA X.O.R. to stop people trading. You cannot have it on those terms.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: We can still borrow the microphone at Nikko. Our answer does not have to stay in this room.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Tonight we race under our own name. The sign and the road home are not for sale.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: The podium microphone is yours. Your usual mechanic’s voice will do. They’re listening.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I’m Aki Soramoto, from SORA Garage. We are going to build SORA X.O.R. here, with this city.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: So nobody can switch off our lives by withdrawing permission. Please help us.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: First, one more working terminal. Let’s warm up the soldering iron when we get back.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: I’ll talk to the harbor. And my brother. This time I’ll wait for his answer.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: May I take a photograph? Not just the cars. Your faces, right now.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Ren. Could you hear my voice shaking?

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: A little. I’m shaking too. I’ll tell you the things that matter. From now on.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Then I’ll leave side B blank a little longer. You can always hear when someone rushed a recording.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: You two can finish watching the sunrise on the way home. The job ends when the borrowed tools are back.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: The forecast says sunshine. The window says downpour. On a synthesizer, I would check the wiring.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: The bakery and the parts shop both have receipts. SORA X.O.R. just became somebody’s breakfast.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: Celebrate, but print the receipts larger. The lady at my delivery stop told me off three times.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Then that is the first repair. My diagram forgot that people have to read it.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: I am taking the photographs to the harbor. Ren, I am leaving you two here. At least fix the leak.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Fixed it. Above Aki’s chair. My side of the room is becoming an ocean.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Move your chair over. You do not have to sit that far away.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: This might be the first time you have offered me something that is not a tool.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Since Dad died, I keep dreaming of closing the garage. Letting someone in feels like having more to lose.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I am afraid to go off air. I think that if I stop talking, nobody will come looking for me.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Yesterday you lost your voice, so I bought throat sweets. In your desk. I came looking for you.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: The cassette’s B-side is still blank. I wanted to record a day when we went somewhere together.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: After the harbor meet, let us take the long way back. I want to talk to you without a microphone.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: It is a date. Tonight’s podium interviews can introduce the shopkeepers too. Our voices are not enough.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: A podium finish. These two coffees are for the pair taking the long way home.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: You did not have to say that loudly enough for the entire harbor.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Stay here until the rain eases. Look, one umbrella is enough.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Your shoulder is soaked. Come closer.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Aki. There is something I want to say without making a joke… Of course the phone rings now.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Mr. Sorai. Your mother’s payment holiday ends this month. Remember your obligations to our sponsor agreement.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I cannot talk now. Yes. I understand.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Who was that? Your hands are shaking.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: The equipment company. Chasing a repair bill. Let us go home.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: All right. But next time, finish what you were going to say.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Tokyo, London, New York. This city’s tomorrow is decided in three boardrooms. It is not decided on a mountain road.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Is there a seat in any of those rooms for the people who live here?

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: CROWN puts Japan at the center of a new world economic order. Join our clearing network and work and capital will follow.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: And if someone is disconnected, they cannot get paid. You are selling permission to participate.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Your X.O.R. is attractive. Keep the SORA name. Give us control over issuance and access.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: Some things need scale to survive. Nobody with the power to help came for my father’s factory.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: And in exchange for protection, we ask you every morning whether we may work?

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Wait. That photograph in the proposal is mine. It was eviction day. You cropped it into a celebration.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: We purchased the rights. That commission bought your new camera, did it not?

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Yes. Then I owe an explanation too. Leaving those people outside the frame was my work as well.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: This is the implementation schedule I retained. Expansion dates, then coordinated withdrawals. These price rises were planned.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Release that and you lose your job. I could keep your name off the broadcast.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: My name is in the approval box. Erase only that and I am doing the same thing again.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Both camps race at Nikko tonight. A podium interview can announce our public briefing. We carry the originals separately.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: They stayed through our podium interview. The shopkeeper in that photograph is coming to the briefing.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: You have not lifted your camera. That is a beautiful sky.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Today I ask first: how would you like to be remembered?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: I left copies of the schedule in two places. If I cannot come tomorrow, do not bury it.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: I will publish my design too. Give me one more night. There are still parts only I can repair.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Mr. Sorai. You gave us the relay locations. Break the agreement and we repossess the equipment.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: You said we were supporting local radio. You never said you would take everyone’s stations away.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: This side of the contract decides the use. Explain that to your mother too.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I will tell them myself on tomorrow’s broadcast.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Ren, are we driving home together? All right. I will go ahead. This time, I will wait for you.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: The tape is cued. Public broadcast at two. If one station stops, another can carry the rest.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: If the other stations have the same equipment, they stop too. We should find another way.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Postpone now? The harbor workers and Rei put their names forward for tonight.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I know. That is why I need to—

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: It will be all right. Your voice will reach them. We can record side B afterward. This time I will speak first.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: The originals are checked. Include my photograph. Start with the part that makes us uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: They told me to return my desk key. I no longer have a place there.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: There is a seat in my car. You might have to share the footwell with a parcel.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: Thank you. Leaving does not erase my responsibility. I will stay to explain all of it.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Each shop has its X.O.R. records. But recovery after a relay failure still depends on me.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: We divide that work when we return. Build a whole stage alone and you always miss a cable.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Aki. After the race, I need you to listen. Before the broadcast. Promise me.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I promise. Tonight we drive home together. Nobody gets left behind.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: First, a podium at Hakone. Tell the clubs when to tune in, then we all come back.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: Two o’clock. The lights are gone. No relays answer. The equipment lessor is here to repossess the studio.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: They cut the garage power too. The records survive. But this arrangement cannot restart from here.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: How did they know every relay location? Only we had that list.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I gave it to them. I signed with the sponsor to buy time for my mother’s debt. I hid it from you.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: That night in the rain? When I told you I was afraid? You knew then?

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I knew. I thought you would leave if I told you. Being afraid does not excuse what I did.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: You hid the choice that should have been mine. I do not want you beside me right now.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I understand. I am leaving the contract and list. I wrote down exactly what I gave them.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Aki, the CROWN records are safe. We cannot pretend tonight did not happen. But we have not lost everything.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Leave me alone for a little while. I cannot record side B tonight.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Would Dad have fixed it all in one night? The power, the radio… me.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: He was good at making it look that way. Open the bottom of the toolbox.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: “Jack: borrowed from the grocer. Wiring: Jun. Picking Aki up: the neighbor.” What is this?

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: His notebook of people to thank. Your father knew how to ask for help.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I was protecting his place by closing the door he always kept open.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: When I left my band, I asked nobody for help either. That unfinished song is still in my drawer.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Play it for us sometime. First… help me. I want to open the garage.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: I was waiting for that. I borrowed extension leads and lunch. You have a lot of people to thank.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I am giving up the recovery key I kept. Each shop must be able to verify and restart without waiting for my permission.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: I will share the design. We will repair the recovery procedure together. No blueprint that only I can touch.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: My signed account. It includes what I approved for CROWN. Changing sides cannot be the end of my responsibility.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I will wait outside. I borrowed replacement equipment. I will face the debt with my mother. I will not pledge you again.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I do not know when I can forgive you. Still, tell everyone what happened. Not as a favor to me.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Yes. And after I speak, I do not get to decide who still calls me a friend.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Let us go to the harbor meet. This time, we use the podium to ask for help. Together, in SORA’s name.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: This is Ren Sorai of SORA Radio. I gave the sponsor your relay details without telling you.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: The agreement and my account are here. I will answer questions, including whether I should stay on air.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: That is a long queue for the microphone. Some people are angry. We will not cut them off.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: Tools, cars, shopfronts people can lend us. All this. Let us agree who returns what first.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Separate terminals checked the same records. Losing one machine does not erase the exchanges.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: We will not become the monarchs of a new currency. SORA X.O.R. must be free of us too.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: The lender examined the originals and paused the garage’s early repayment demand. Restoring the old repayment plan is the next negotiation.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: The repairs are finished. I am going home now. Good night, Aki.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Good night. Tomorrow’s work starts at eight. If you come, do not be late.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: All right. The first note, on borrowed power. We can write the rest together.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: I redrew the delivery rota. Red pencil means my runs. There are fewer now.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: You were going to drive everything from the harbor to Nikko yourself.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: I was. Everyone found a route that still gets me home for dinner with my brother.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Two copies of each document. Names approved for publication; private addresses covered.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: Ask the recipients to cross-check them too. My explanation should not be the final word.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Here is the repair exchange terminal. The greengrocer noticed I left out what happens during a blackout.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: Even a beautiful circuit diagram needs somewhere to put the flashlight.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Exactly. They marked up the SORA X.O.R. plans. They made them better than I could alone.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Repair costs for the relays I exposed, and what the sponsor paid me. This week’s account goes on the wall.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: You stayed late again. You do not think losing sleep can repay everything, do you?

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: No. Jun takes over tomorrow. I am learning to make promises I can actually keep.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: It still hurts. But I can listen to that. Keep going without hiding anything.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: The Nikko drivers will carry the next leg. Tonight, we get to come home too.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: A podium gives us a slot before closing. We have something to pass on beyond the finish line.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I saw them from the podium. Envelopes lined up beside everyone’s toolboxes.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: Every handoff is signed. My job was getting things to the next person, not driving every mile.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: The harbor photographs went too, with captions corrected by the people in them.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: I accepted the barber’s revision. People who decline the exchange can still use the workshop.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: A good sign leaves room to say no. I will keep a repair bench available too.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: The public hearing has a date. We are inviting questions, not only supporters.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: A relay owner corrected my account. I left out their two days of lost work.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I saw the correction beside your first account. You left the uncomfortable part visible.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Erasing it would be the same mistake again. I am still stuck on tonight’s playlist, though.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Coffee after the show, then. I can help you argue with a playlist.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Your father’s workshop. We take over its debt. Your name and the sign can stay.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: You even put a key in the envelope. I have not answered yet.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: You would approve SORA X.O.R. access. The Meridian Council would handle the decisions above yours.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Where would someone go if you refused them access?

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Approved work and trade create order. CROWN will extend that world, city by city.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: As a child, I guarded the key at Dad’s desk. I thought keeping everyone out would keep it safe.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Now you really could protect it. You need never lose it because of someone else’s decision.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Dad’s notebook named everyone who helped. One person holding a key cannot keep a workshop running.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Take the key back. Saving my garage is not worth closing everyone else’s road home.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Then our support for the venue’s line ends tonight. How many people will your ideals reach?

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: The venue called. Their line is down. Repair friends have brought spare transmitters.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: If one station drops, another takes over. Every owner knows where their equipment and operators will be.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: My terminal is on a borrowed generator today. Ideals need a surprising number of extension leads.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Let us make the Hakone podium. Then we give the microphone to the people with questions.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: The venue is full. They want the hearing notice on the wall before the race photographs.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: This is the assessment I approved. I will read the passages I signed despite knowing their consequences.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Original copies and objections are circulating. Applause and evidence must stand on their own.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: Can you hear us, harbor? I once walked away from a stage. Tonight I will keep the sound going.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Loud and clear. Next, questions from the shopping street. Corrections to my account get the same microphone.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Some questions for Rei were hard. But people are sitting here and talking.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: When my father’s factory closed, I had nowhere to ask questions. You have built that place.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: We are still building it. We want to hear your answers here too.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: At the final harbor meet. I will bring something I can offer myself, not another company slogan.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Then everyone hears the terms before we drive. No more quietly wagering someone else’s life.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: These are my personal purchase options on the workshop and harbor plots. Every address is listed.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: These are rights Toru can personally release, not property belonging to residents or the company. I checked the documents.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: Make the podium and finish ahead of me, and I release them. That is my promise before everyone.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I will not stake anyone else’s rights. Losing cannot take away our right to demand answers.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: Agreed. Ever since the factory closed, I believed only the stronger side could keep a promise.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Terms and signatures photographed. The finishing order will not decide whether the evidence is real.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: Release one district if you wish. The Council’s capital still moves. There are other contracts beyond this harbor.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: That is why the records are traveling. Protecting this harbor will not end the world’s argument.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: Right rear temperature is steady. You do not have to decide everything at the first corner.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Fear used to make me floor it. Today I am leaving myself a line back out.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: The pit duties are shared. Nobody gets left behind when I stop doing everything.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I am here to commentate, not drive through your headset. When you need me, I will be here.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Good. When this is over, there is something I want to tell you. Nothing to do with excuses or results.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: To the grid, Soramoto. This time, I will see the place you are trying to come home to.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: A podium, ahead of Toru. I made it back. Can everyone hear me?

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: We hear you. The conditions are met. I release my options. Here are the originals, as promised.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: Copies go to everyone. The garage’s early repayment demand is formally withdrawn. The original debt, and my responsibility, remain.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Local investors have suspended CROWN, citing the corroborated records and the public hearing.

lines.speaker: celeste
lines.en: It has stopped at this harbor. The Meridian Council will continue making decisions in the next city.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Then the next town gets another choice too. This does not end with one person losing.

lines.speaker: toru
lines.en: Trying to recover my father’s factory, I nearly took someone else’s. I will stay and answer for that.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: We can deliver bread tomorrow morning. I am calling my brother. This time, we can buy the car parts.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: The harbor is so quiet with the engines off. Take your time. You can talk when you choose.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I am coming to hear the sunrise show. Bring that cassette. Is side B still blank?

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: One more line beneath the sign: if you have something to repair, knock.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: Your dad would like that. Even the people who never returned his tools might come back.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: We will ask for them back. Then make tea. I kept remembering Dad as someone who worked alone.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: The rota is up. Publishing how to fix things while I am away made my shoulders feel lighter.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.en: The original installments are restored. Repairs pay the debt, with reserves for bad months. My own investigation continues.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: The book opens with someone holding an eviction notice, in their own words and a photograph they chose.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: My brother’s car starts. First stop: driving school. I told him to listen to the instructor, not my boasting.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: I finished the song I abandoned. Repairing other people’s sound had become a place to hide my own.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: We will play it on the sunrise show. Nikko first; then we come back and raise the workshop shutters.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: That is still the same cassette in your pocket. The corners have worn white.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Side B is still blank. But giving it to you never entitled me to ask you to fill it.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: I know. Today I want to carry it. And decide for myself whether to press record.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: Invitations from other towns are waiting at Nikko. After the podium, we can open them one by one.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Let us go. We can set out again from the place we saved. That must be what coming home means.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.en: One last podium photograph. Reopening photos when we get back. Nobody hide behind the sign this time.

lines.speaker: daichi
lines.en: My brother says he is buying breakfast. Little by little, I get to be the one someone looks after.

lines.speaker: yui
lines.en: A distant workshop sent a correction and a thank-you. SORA X.O.R. has outgrown my desk.

lines.speaker: jun
lines.en: To everyone listening to SORA Radio: a new song, a long time coming. This time, I am playing it through.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Aki has the cassette. A little more music after the show. There is someone I want to see too.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Ren, I love you. Not because I need you to return. I want to keep meeting the person here beside me.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: I love you too. At the workshop, or driving somewhere far away. Let us stay close and keep our own roads.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: May I kiss you? And please keep this answer off the air.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Yes. I want that too. The tape is stopped. This moment belongs to us.

lines.speaker: aki
lines.en: Our first kiss stays ours. I am pressing record. Can side B start with “I am hungry”?

lines.speaker: ren
lines.en: Absolutely. Let us go home, Aki. The rest of side B can wait until after breakfast.

retry.speaker: daichi
retry.en: You made it back. Let your shoulders drop. Next run, take a breath before the corner.

retry.speaker: jun
retry.en: Open the notebook. Enter slower; accelerate out. Save the drift for where you need to turn.

retry.speaker: aki
retry.en: Right. I watched the clock and lost the road. Next time, I’ll drive like I have somewhere to come home to.
